ios.desc:
The blood calls your name.  Join the blood rondo in a massive gothic-horror RPG as you duel vampires to become the most powerful hunters in life and undeath!

The acclaimed World of Blood RPG series features hundreds of hours of adventure, stories, quests, and powerful items.  Find old and new friends in a dark and bloody world.

FEATURES
- 100+ towns of adventures and action, spanning life and undeath.
- 200+ items with powerful abilities.
- Chat with others and make new allies.
- Customize your character portrait.
- Battle with friends for extra rewards.
- Become a Legend on the leaderboards.
- Epic storyline
